units: <cite ref="Shabbat 134a:13">Sabb. 134ᵃ</cite> <he>האי ינוקא דלא מ׳</he> an infant that does not suck.
<cite ref="Shabbat 133b:14">Ib. 133ᵇ</cite> <he>אומנא דלא מ׳</he> a surgeon (circumciser) that fails to suck the blood out of the wound.—

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 32a:2">Ab. Zar. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>ומָיְיצֵי להו וכ׳</he> and they (the earthen vessels) resorb the wine (Ms. M. <he>עד דמצי וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M02307"><he>מְצֵי</he></cite>).
